name: start
js: const T={levels:{keep:18,wall:18,towers:18,barracks:12,lair:12},seed:11,ratio:1.1,power:4500,loot:{turq:60,emerald:60,ruby:60},tesla:0,emblem:'swords',name:'Navid'}; __bw.battle.start(T,null,null); for(let i=0;i<1200;i++){ await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500)); if(__bw.battle.session && !__bw.battle.loading) break; } const S=__bw.battle.session; S.cam.intro=0; return {ok:!!S, camp:!!S.camp, dp:[S.sim.deploy.x|0,S.sim.deploy.z|0], tg:S.sim.buildings.filter(b=>b.type==='training').length};

name: camp0
js: const S=__bw.battle.session; S.hud.el.style.display='none'; const dp=S.sim.deploy; const cx=dp.x+dp.nx*62+(-dp.nz)*(-24), cz=dp.z+dp.nz*62+dp.nx*(-24); S.cam.tx=cx; S.cam.tz=cz; S.cam.dist=70; S.cam.az=S.cam.az0+Math.PI*0.9; return {c:[cx|0,cz|0]};

name: fight
js: const S=__bw.battle.session, sim=S.sim; S.hud.el.style.display=''; S.started=true; const keep=sim.buildings.find(b=>b.type==='keep'); for(const t of S.types){ const u=sim.units.find(x=>x.type===t); if(u&&u.air) continue; sim.send(t,keep.x,keep.z);} for(let i=0;i<420;i++){ sim.step(0.1); } const BIG=new Set(['giant','dragon','baby','hill','shieldmaiden','lord','werewolf','trebuchet']); let best=null; const bs=sim.buildings.filter(b=>!b.dead&&b.type!=='wall'); for(const u of sim.units){ if(u.dead||!BIG.has(u.type)) continue; for(const b of bs){ const d=Math.hypot(u.x-b.x,u.z-b.z); if(!best||d<best.d) best={u,b,d}; } } if(!best) return {none:true}; if(best.u.hp>=best.u.maxHp) best.u.hp=best.u.maxHp*0.62; if(best.b.hp>=best.b.maxHp) best.b.hp=best.b.maxHp*0.55; S.cam.tx=(best.u.x+best.b.x)/2; S.cam.tz=(best.u.z+best.b.z)/2; S.cam.dist=70; S.cam.az=S.cam.az0; return {u:best.u.type,b:best.b.type,d:best.d|0,t:sim.time|0};
